subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) The king followed the advice of the physician. (b) He advised the king to move a heavy club in the air till he got tired. (c) He did not undergo physical labour. (d) The doctor was very wise. (e) He became bulky and could not do anything. (f) There was once an idle king. (g) He did not prescribe any medicine. (h) He called in a doctor.
guide_solution: f → c → e → h → d → g → b → a
